title: Privacy Policy
description: Privacy information for the Homeward Charities website, scheduling and contact services.
html:
Homeward Charities is the public brand used on this website. This notice describes the website and connected services reviewed for the domain transition.

Visiting this website

Netlify hosts and delivers these pages and may process technical request information, including IP addresses, requested URLs and browser information, to deliver and secure its service. Google Fonts supplies fonts used by the website.

Scheduling a conversation

The Let’s Talk page embeds Calendly. Loading or using that calendar connects your browser to Calendly, which may use its own cookies and process booking details such as your name, email address, selected time and information you enter. Review Calendly’s privacy notice and its cookie settings. You can also email Shaun instead of using the embedded calendar. Meetings use the conferencing service indicated during booking.

Contact and reflection information

If you submit a Homeward contact or reflection form, its information may be processed through Netlify, recorded in Airtable and used to send requested resources or notifications through Resend. Reflection responses can reveal personal religious or spiritual beliefs. Share only what you are comfortable providing; avoid confidential information about other people. A request for a conversation or resource is separate from an optional newsletter subscription.

The current public pages do not include the earlier spiritual assessment interface, but the existing contact-processing endpoint is retained for established integrations. This notice does not imply that assessment information is anonymous.

Analytics and optional tracking

The current public v1.7 page templates do not load Google Analytics or a Meta advertising pixel. Embedded third-party services and hosting logs are separate from page analytics and may process technical information. This notice does not describe every service’s independent practices; use their notices and available choices.

Questions and requests

To ask about information you have provided, its use or retention, or to request access, correction or deletion, email shaun@homewardcommunity.com. Please do not email sensitive assessment responses merely to identify a request. Retention schedules and organizational privacy procedures are being reviewed; no fixed retention period or legal-compliance certification is represented here.

title: Accessibility Statement
description: How to request help accessing Homeward Charities information and experiences.
html:
Homeward Charities aims to make its public website usable by people with different access needs. We use WCAG 2.2 Level AA as a technical review target. This is not a claim of certification or that every page or third-party service is fully conformant.

Using this website

Pages include a skip-to-content link, visible keyboard focus, labelled navigation and image descriptions. The navigation menu can be opened with its button and closed with Escape. Text can be enlarged using your browser controls.

Scheduling and third-party content

The embedded calendar is supplied by Calendly and is reviewed separately from our page code. If it is difficult to use, email Shaun to arrange a conversation. Older downloadable PDFs and third-party tools may have accessibility limitations.

Ask for assistance or report a barrier

Contact shaun@homewardcommunity.com with the page address, what you were trying to do and the format or assistance that would help. You may include your browser or assistive technology if useful. Do not include confidential personal information. We can discuss another way to provide the information or arrange a conversation.
